fields.why: 155 m³/h of flotation process water was sent to the DMS process water tank for a period of time. The volume carried ultrafine solids into the DMS process water tank, causing foaming in the DMS circuit and production loss.
fields.design:
- Add a High alarm setpoint to 910-FIT-2440 – initial value 100 m³/h
- Setpoint adjustable through metallurgy login
fields.impact: CROs will receive a high flow alarm on 910-FIT-2440 at 100 m³/h. Metallurgy can adjust the alarm setpoint.
